# Gate 1 package - BI-PF-1314
**EDP-22: Benchmarks/SLOs + EXPLAIN(ANALYZE,BUFFERS) tuning + observability + quotas + graceful degradation (DB/object/cache/queue)**

## Plain language
**What/why:** No repeatable performance baselines, SLOs, or degradation strategy exist across DB/object/cache/queue. -> Benchmark harness, EXPLAIN-based tuning, observability, quotas, and graceful degradation switches.

## Gate 0 reconciliation + impact
RECONCILIATION - BI-PF-1314
  prior_decisions : ['EDP-06 baseline harness landed with a Sink seam reserved for EDP-22.', 'EDP-19/20/21 stores and EDP-18 migration framework are complete.']
  existing_path   : ['go/edpsvc/internal/bench', 'go/edpsvc/internal/limits', 'scripts/dev/db_explain_check.py', 'ops/prometheus']
  assumptions     : ['PostgreSQL is the primary store.', 'Prometheus/Grafana-compatible observability is the target.', 'SLO numbers are set from measured local baselines first.', 'EDP-24 scale-out remains evidence-gated.']
  divergences     : ['EDP-22 does not add replicas or partitioning; it produces the evidence those decisions require.']
  open_questions  : ['Which deployment-specific SLO targets should override conservative defaults?']
IMPACT REVIEW
  claim | verdict | evidence | recommendation
  API CHECK: no new public API; benchmark CLI and ops tooling only. | aligned | go/edpsvc/cmd/bench | keep internal/ops-only
  AC CHECK: four acceptance criteria mapped to four slices. | aligned | design_pack.coverage AC-1..AC-4 | verify at Gate 2
  LANGUAGE CHECK: shipped performance tooling in Go; EXPLAIN helper in Python tooling. | aligned | go/edpsvc/internal/bench + scripts/dev | no new shipped Python path
  SLO CHECK: bounded metric labels per store/scenario; no tenant labels. | aligned | ops/prometheus/edp-slo.rules.yml | no high-cardinality labels
  DEGRADATION CHECK: switches must fail closed and be observable. | aligned | config/edp-slo.json | alert on each degradation transition

## Current stage
**complete**

## Gate 1.5 findings + architect recommendation
Gate 1.5 - Findings & Dispositions (model=deepseek-v4.1-flash sha=2e18a4d28fff)
**Overall architect recommendation: APPROVE**
Findings: 17 (BLOCKER 3 / MAJOR 8 / MINOR 4 / NIT 2); dispositions: actioned 17; all blockers/majors actioned
status: PENDING | ACTIONED | ACCEPTED | DEFERRED | REJECTED | SCOPE

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition | Response / resolution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | BLOCKER | AC-3 is not designed: open question on whether object/cache/queue expose counters means per-store SLO dashboards/alerts cannot be shown to exist; no adapter instrumentation files are in scope. | ACTIONED | Design updated: per-store metrics/degradation, read-only redacted EXPLAIN, measured baselines and bounded expiry; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1314.md, docs/EDP-22-BENCHMARKS-SLOS.md. evidence: go/edpsvc/internal/degrade/policy.go, scripts/dev/db_explain_capture.py. |
| 2 | BLOCKER | AC-4 is not designed: quota enforcement and per-store degradation switches reference `go/edpsvc/internal/limits` but no affected file, config schema, or test defines quotas/switch behavior per store. | ACTIONED | Design updated: per-store metrics/degradation, read-only redacted EXPLAIN, measured baselines and bounded expiry; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1314.md, docs/EDP-22-BENCHMARKS-SLOS.md. evidence: go/edpsvc/internal/degrade/policy.go, scripts/dev/db_explain_capture.py. |
| 3 | BLOCKER | DB access for benchmark and EXPLAIN capture has no least-privilege/read-only role or RLS enforcement; “tenant-safe” invariant lacks a boundary control and risks admin/RLS-bypass DSNs. | ACTIONED | Design updated: per-store metrics/degradation, read-only redacted EXPLAIN, measured baselines and bounded expiry; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1314.md, docs/EDP-22-BENCHMARKS-SLOS.md. evidence: go/edpsvc/internal/degrade/policy.go, scripts/dev/db_explain_capture.py. |
| 4 | MAJOR | AC-1 lacks baseline artifact definition: no storage location, versioning, environment fingerprint, variance tolerance, or retention for recorded baselines, so repeatability is not verifiable. | ACTIONED | Design updated: per-store metrics/degradation, read-only redacted EXPLAIN, measured baselines and bounded expiry; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1314.md, docs/EDP-22-BENCHMARKS-SLOS.md. evidence: go/edpsvc/internal/degrade/policy.go, scripts/dev/db_explain_capture.py. |
| 5 | MAJOR | AC-1 failure case “missing DSN -> skipped scenarios” can produce a green run without per-store coverage; it should fail closed or record explicit skipped-store evidence. | ACTIONED | Design updated: per-store metrics/degradation, read-only redacted EXPLAIN, measured baselines and bounded expiry; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1314.md, docs/EDP-22-BENCHMARKS-SLOS.md. evidence: go/edpsvc/internal/degrade/policy.go, scripts/dev/db_explain_capture.py. |
| 6 | MAJOR | AC-2 prod enforcement is underspecified: no environment detection and no hard production cap preventing `sample_rate=1.0`; sampling-only policy can be bypassed by config. | ACTIONED | Design updated: per-store metrics/degradation, read-only redacted EXPLAIN, measured baselines and bounded expiry; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1314.md, docs/EDP-22-BENCHMARKS-SLOS.md. evidence: go/edpsvc/internal/degrade/policy.go, scripts/dev/db_explain_capture.py. |
| 7 | MAJOR | AC-2 `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` executes statements; no read-only transaction, statement allowlist, statement timeout, or rollback guard is defined. | ACTIONED | Design updated: per-store metrics/degradation, read-only redacted EXPLAIN, measured baselines and bounded expiry; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1314.md, docs/EDP-22-BENCHMARKS-SLOS.md. evidence: go/edpsvc/internal/degrade/policy.go, scripts/dev/db_explain_capture.py. |
| 8 | MAJOR | AC-2 redaction of parameters/tenant data is declared but has no mechanism or test evidence; captured plans can leak literals/tenant data. | ACTIONED | Design updated: per-store metrics/degradation, read-only redacted EXPLAIN, measured baselines and bounded expiry; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1314.md, docs/EDP-22-BENCHMARKS-SLOS.md. evidence: go/edpsvc/internal/degrade/policy.go, scripts/dev/db_explain_capture.py. |
| 9 | MAJOR | AC-3 validation is weak: Python config tests do not prove Prometheus rule semantics, alert lead time, or Grafana dashboard/schema validity; scrape/eval intervals remain open. | ACTIONED | Design updated: per-store metrics/degradation, read-only redacted EXPLAIN, measured baselines and bounded expiry; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1314.md, docs/EDP-22-BENCHMARKS-SLOS.md. evidence: go/edpsvc/internal/degrade/policy.go, scripts/dev/db_explain_capture.py. |
| 10 | MAJOR | AC-4 “bounded” degradation is not quantified: no max duration, auto-expiry, quota-denied metric, or alert-routing handoff is defined. | ACTIONED | Design updated: per-store metrics/degradation, read-only redacted EXPLAIN, measured baselines and bounded expiry; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1314.md, docs/EDP-22-BENCHMARKS-SLOS.md. evidence: go/edpsvc/internal/degrade/policy.go, scripts/dev/db_explain_capture.py. |
| 11 | MAJOR | SLO thresholds are not tied to measured baselines; open deployment overrides and aspirational values risk alert noise or missed regressions. | ACTIONED | Design updated: per-store metrics/degradation, read-only redacted EXPLAIN, measured baselines and bounded expiry; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1314.md, docs/EDP-22-BENCHMARKS-SLOS.md. evidence: go/edpsvc/internal/degrade/policy.go, scripts/dev/db_explain_capture.py. |
| 12 | MINOR | Benchmark reconstruction metadata is incomplete: concurrency, dataset seed/size, host class, and run duration should be recorded with baselines. | ACTIONED | Design updated: per-store metrics/degradation, read-only redacted EXPLAIN, measured baselines and bounded expiry; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1314.md, docs/EDP-22-BENCHMARKS-SLOS.md. evidence: go/edpsvc/internal/degrade/policy.go, scripts/dev/db_explain_capture.py. |
| 13 | MINOR | Mixing SLO policy and runtime quota/degradation policy in `config/edp-slo.json` blurs ownership and rollback boundaries. | ACTIONED | Design updated: per-store metrics/degradation, read-only redacted EXPLAIN, measured baselines and bounded expiry; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1314.md, docs/EDP-22-BENCHMARKS-SLOS.md. evidence: go/edpsvc/internal/degrade/policy.go, scripts/dev/db_explain_capture.py. |
| 14 | MINOR | Captured EXPLAIN artifacts need explicit retention and access-control policy beyond “redacted”. | ACTIONED | Design updated: per-store metrics/degradation, read-only redacted EXPLAIN, measured baselines and bounded expiry; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1314.md, docs/EDP-22-BENCHMARKS-SLOS.md. evidence: go/edpsvc/internal/degrade/policy.go, scripts/dev/db_explain_capture.py. |
| 15 | MINOR | Quota enforcement observability lacks clear denied/allowed counters and bounded store labels. | ACTIONED | Design updated: per-store metrics/degradation, read-only redacted EXPLAIN, measured baselines and bounded expiry; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1314.md, docs/EDP-22-BENCHMARKS-SLOS.md. evidence: go/edpsvc/internal/degrade/policy.go, scripts/dev/db_explain_capture.py. |
| 16 | NIT | `scripts/dev/db_explain_capture.py` is acceptable as tooling, but its prod guardrails should be documented alongside ops runbooks. | ACTIONED | Design updated: per-store metrics/degradation, read-only redacted EXPLAIN, measured baselines and bounded expiry; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1314.md, docs/EDP-22-BENCHMARKS-SLOS.md. evidence: go/edpsvc/internal/degrade/policy.go, scripts/dev/db_explain_capture.py. |
| 17 | NIT | Single evidence doc `docs/EDP-22-BENCHMARKS-SLOS.md` should index baseline artifacts, rule files, dashboards, and per-store proof. | ACTIONED | Design updated: per-store metrics/degradation, read-only redacted EXPLAIN, measured baselines and bounded expiry; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1314.md, docs/EDP-22-BENCHMARKS-SLOS.md. evidence: go/edpsvc/internal/degrade/policy.go, scripts/dev/db_explain_capture.py. |

--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  Design is directionally sound on bounded labels, fail-closed regression, and default-off rollout, but AC-3 and AC-4 are not yet demonstrable.
  Top risks: missing per-store SLO/counter coverage, undefined quota/degradation implementation evidence, and insufficient DB privilege/RLS and EXPLAIN redaction controls.
  AC-1/AC-2 need stronger repeatability, environment, sampling, and read-only execution contracts before Gate 1.5.
